title: Philadelphia: a City Famous for its History
summary: Филадельфи бол АНУ-ын түүхэнд чухал байр суурьтай, музей, хоолоороо алдартай хот.

questions.prompt: What is Philadelphia most famous for?
options: Its important place in American history
Its many tall and modern office buildings
Its large and famous sports stadiums
questions.explain: "Philadelphia is famous for holding an important place in American history" гэж бичсэн.
"That was where colonial leaders declared independence" гэж бичсэн. Энэ бол Independence Hall.

questions.prompt: The best Philly cheesesteak is "the subject of much debate." What does this mean?
options: People do not agree about it
questions.explain: "Subject of much debate" гэдэг нь хүмүүс энэ талаар маргалддаг, санал нийлдэггүй гэсэн үг.
